# flashblade_resiliency_group_member (Data Source)

Reads a single FlashBlade resiliency group member by parent group name and member name. Member rows are hardware-managed group-to-resource associations reported by the array (API 2.23+).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "flashblade_resiliency_group_member" "example" {
  resiliency_group_name = "rg0"
  member_name           = "fs-alpha"
}

output "resiliency_group_member_resource_type" {
  value = data.flashblade_resiliency_group_member.example.member_resource_type
}

output "resiliency_group_member_id" {
  value = data.flashblade_resiliency_group_member.example.member_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_name` (String) Name of the member resource to look up within the resiliency group.
- `resiliency_group_name` (String) Name of the parent resiliency group whose member rows should be searched.

### Read-Only

- `group_id` (String) Non-modifiable globally unique identifier of the parent resiliency group.
- `group_resource_type` (String) API resource type of the parent group reference (typically `resiliency-groups`).
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `<resiliency_group_name>/<member_name>`.
- `member_id` (String) Non-modifiable globally unique identifier of the member resource.
- `member_resource_type` (String) API resource type of the member reference (e.g. `file-systems`).
